changes.beforeContent:
# import: the PR, read once, then its one review ticket — found by pr_url, or
# created. Nothing on GitHub is written: `gh pr view` is the only gh call.
pr="" imported=""
if [ "$cmd" = import ]; then
  need_session_key
  pr_url=${pr_url%/}
  printf '%s' "$pr_url" | grep -qiE '^https://github\.com/primarykids/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+/pull/[0-9]+$' \
    || die "'$pr_url' is not a PrimaryKids pull request URL (https://github.com/PrimaryKids/<repo>/pull/<n>)"
  [ -n "$project_arg" ] || die "--project is required: the board project the review ticket goes on"
  project=$(kk-project "$project_arg") || exit 1
  pr=$(gh pr view "$pr_url" --json number,title,body,url,author,baseRefOid,headRefOid,baseRefName,headRefName </dev/null) \
    || die "gh could not read $pr_url; nothing was created" 4
  is_sha "$(jq -r '.headRefOid // ""' <<< "$pr")" && is_sha "$(jq -r '.baseRefOid // ""' <<< "$pr")" \
    || die "gh returned no base and head commit for $pr_url" 4
  pr_url=$(jq -r '.url' <<< "$pr")
  found=$(kk_issue_list --project "$project" --metadata "pr_url=$pr_url" 2>/dev/null \
            | jq -r '[.issues[]? | select(.metadata.review_kind == "external")] | .[0].identifier // empty') \
    || die "could not search the board for $pr_url" 4
  if [ -n "$found" ]; then
    ticket=$found imported=existing
  else
    created=$(jq -r '"Read-only review of \(.url) by \(.author.login // "?"), at exactly",
                     "head \(.headRefOid) on base \(.baseRefOid) (\(.baseRefName)).", "",
                     "Nothing here pushes, posts to GitHub or involves Gatekeeper. Created by kk-packet import."' <<< "$pr" \
              | multica issue create --title "$(jq -r '"Review PR #\(.number): \(.title)"' <<< "$pr")" \
                  --project "$project" --description-stdin --output json) \
      || die "could not create the review ticket for $pr_url" 4
    ticket=$(jq -r '.identifier // empty' <<< "$created")
    [ -n "$ticket" ] || die "the review ticket for $pr_url was created but its identifier was not returned" 4
    imported=new
    # pr_url first: it is what a re-run finds the ticket by.
    for kv in "pr_url=$pr_url" review_kind=external \
              "pr_number=$(jq -r .number <<< "$pr")" "pr_author=$(jq -r '.author.login // ""' <<< "$pr")" \
              "review_base_sha=$(jq -r .baseRefOid <<< "$pr")" "review_head_sha=$(jq -r .headRefOid <<< "$pr")"; do
      multica issue metadata set "$ticket" --key "${kv%%=*}" --value "${kv#*=}" >/dev/null </dev/null \
        || die "could not record ${kv%%=*} on $ticket" 4
    done
  fi
fi

# One build at a time per ticket (PER-79). Taken before the ticket is read, so
# a second trigger decides from what the first one recorded and resumes it.
if [ "$cmd" = start ] || [ "$cmd" = ensure ]; then
  lock_dir="$STATE_ROOT/${KK_WS_NAME:-default}/$ticket"
  if ! { mkdir -p "$lock_dir" && exec 9>"$lock_dir/build.lock"; }; then
    die "could not open $lock_dir/build.lock" 4
  fi
  flock -w "${KK_PACKET_LOCK_WAIT:-300}" 9 \
    || die "another start or ensure on $ticket held its lock past ${KK_PACKET_LOCK_WAIT:-300}s; rerun" 4
fi

issue=$(multica issue get "$ticket" --output json 2>/dev/null </dev/null || true)
issue_id=$(printf '%s' "$issue" | jq -r '.id // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$issue_id" ]; then
  kk_ws_no_ticket "kk-packet $cmd $ticket" "$ticket"
  exit 3
fi
title=$(printf '%s' "$issue" | jq -r '.title // ""')

changes.beforeContent:
project_id=$(printf '%s' "$issue" | jq -r '.project_id // empty')
project_name=$project_id
if [ -n "$project_id" ]; then
  project_name=$(kk-project --name "$project_id" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$project_id")
fi

case "$cmd" in

brief)
  need_session_key
  case "$state" in
    built|briefed|ready|feedback) ;;
    # A reader's revise is spent by the draft it asks for: the next brief is
    # the next round.
    revise) round=$((round + 1)) ;;
    stalled) die "$ticket is stalled: ${stalled_why:-after $round draft(s)}
  Take it to Ethan or $PROGRAMMER; another brief of the same kind will not fix it." 9 ;;
    *) die "$ticket has no built packet to brief on (state: ${state:-none})" 6 ;;
  esac
  [ -f "$bundle/packet.json" ] || die "the recorded bundle $bundle is gone — offer a new packet" 4
  send_brief
  exit 0
  ;;

read)
  need_session_key
  [ "$state" = reading ] || die "$ticket is not waiting on the reader (state: ${state:-none})" 6
  [ -f "$bundle/packet.json" ] || die "the recorded bundle $bundle is gone" 4
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  [ "$attempt" -le "$MAX_READS" ] \
    || die "$READER has had $MAX_READS briefs on draft $round; run finish, which stops the workflow here" 9
  send_read
  exit 0
  ;;

start|ensure)
  need_session_key
  if [ "$external" = true ]; then
    [ -z "$pr_stale" ] \
      || die "$ticket is STALE: PR #$pr_number moved to ${pr_stale:0:12}. Its review stays bound to ${review_head:0:12}; nothing is built." 7
    is_sha "$review_head" && is_sha "$review_base" \
      || die "$ticket records no pinned PR base and head; run kk-packet import again" 4
    if { [ -n "$base_ref" ] && [ "$base_ref" != "$review_base" ]; } || { [ -n "$head_ref" ] && [ "$head_ref" != "$review_head" ]; }; then
      die "$ticket is pinned to PR #$pr_number's base and head; --base and --head cannot change them"
    fi
    base_ref=$review_base head_ref=$review_head
  fi
  if [ "$cmd" = start ] && [ "$state" != approved ]; then
    cat >&2 <<ERR
kk-packet: NOT APPROVED: no review packet for $ticket yet (state: ${state:-none}).

A packet is built only when Ethan asks for one. Ask him:

  kk-packet offer $ticket

and on his yes, record it with 'kk-packet yes $ticket' before starting.
ERR
    exit 6
  fi
  past=$(history)
  yes_note=""
  [ "$cmd" = ensure ] || yes_note="Ethan's yes still stands."

  # Recorded before anything is built, so a build that fails later still
  # leaves the ticket gated: `pending` covers every revision until the build
  # names the one this packet is for.
  was_required=$(meta packet_review_required)
  [ "$cmd" = ensure ] || set_meta packet_review_required pending
  # A build that finds nothing new puts back the revision it replaced: left at
  # `pending`, it gated every revision and hid the packet Ethan had just been
  # sent (PER-59).
